rows.grounds: adjective describing the cakra as kingly
numeral forming first member of compound with patra
noun forming second member of compound with aṣṭa
adjective indicating presence of a pericarp

items.question: What form and attributes characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: It is endowed with a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled wheel with a pericarp.
items.plain_english: The sixth cakra, moreover, is royal, has eight petals, and includes a pericarp.
